trust_decision.summary:
Decided: a URI attribute value whose scheme is split by an HTML5 named whitespace character reference (`	`, `
`) must be rejected, and the decision is made once, inside `Loofah::HTML5::Scrub.allowed_uri?`, for every attribute listed in `SafeList::ATTR_VAL_IS_URI` (reached through `scrub_uri_attribute`).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names `allowed_uri?` verbatim; it is the only function that decides URI safety, and its sole in-repo caller `scrub_uri_attribute` (scrub.rb:188-195) is a three-line wrapper that just removes the attribute when it returns false.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
Named character references are case-sensitive in browsers: `	`/`
` are decoded but `&tab;`/`&NEWLINE;` are not, so `allowed_uri?` must keep returning true for the wrong-cased forms (and for relative and safe `data:` URIs). An over-broad case-insensitive strip, or a strip applied after the existing `.downcase` at the end of the chain, wrongly rejects safe input; a naive in-place `gsub!` on the argument also breaks frozen-string callers.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CSS scrub path that allowlists `url()` values against the protocol list instead of dropping every `url`/`bad_url` node
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Users file issues when sanitizing eats legitimate `background-image: url(...)`; a maintainer would naturally add a scheme check there and would need the same entity/named-reference normalisation and ordering as `allowed_uri?`.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second parser (`data_uri_mediatype`) that reads the same already-entity-decoded URI string and re-splits it on `:` and `;`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already re-parses the string `allowed_uri?` produced, so any whitespace/named-reference normalisation has to be duplicated or the mediatype decision drifts from the protocol decision.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a local-reference scrubber for SVG presentation attributes (`fill`, `filter`, `cursor`, ...) that validates the parsed `url()` value against the protocol list instead of only accepting values starting with `#`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The current rule is blunt; a maintainer answering a bug about legitimate `url(...)` references would extend it, and would then have to reuse the same decode-then-strip order.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a wrapper/composition scrubber (`:targetblank`) that inspects `href` itself and treats anything not starting with `#` as an external link
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already makes a mini-decision about `href` shape outside the scrub module; a maintainer tightening it (e.g. skipping `data:` or javascript links) would add a second, divergent URI check.
